items.text: On phones the top of the screen is about half as tall: the date and time sit on two tight lines with the buttons beside them, and the greeting is hidden to save room. Tablets and computers are unchanged.
On the Calendar page the Calendars, previous, Today and next buttons now sit on their own row under the date instead of squeezing the date into a narrow column.

Settings now has six tabs grouped by what you are doing: This screen (who uses this device, light/dark, notifications, Face ID, Arrange Main page, Full screen, Sign out), Household (name, family, photo screensaver), Morning text, Guest mode, Features (admin), and More (Budget, History, change log, examples).
Each tab says at the top whether it affects only this screen or everyone. Save and Cancel only appear on Household, the one tab that needs them; everything else saves right away.

title: Meals for Jason, for Abby, or both

items.text: Each meal on the Meal plan can be marked for specific people. Pick names when you add a meal, or tap the person icon on a planned meal. Their initials (J, A) show on the meal, on the Calendar and in the morning briefing. Leave it empty for everyone.

title: We had it keeps the meal on the plan

items.text: Tapping “We had it” (or the ✓ on a planned meal) now saves it to History but leaves it on the plan, with the ✓ filled in. Tap it again to undo.
Open any dish in Our dishes and tap History to see every time you made it, how long ago the last time was, and add or remove past dates.

title: Lunch, eating out and on your own

items.text: The weekly Meal plan now has a Lunch and a Dinner slot for every day.

When adding a meal, besides picking a dish you can choose Eating out or On your own, with an optional note such as the restaurant. These show on the plan, on the Calendar, on the Main page’s dinner card and in the morning briefing.
Past and today’s planned meals get a ✓ (“We had it”) that saves them to History, for lunches and Eating out / On your own too. History marks each meal as Lunch or Dinner.
A dish planned for lunch now shows “Lunch” and its day on its tile.

title: Preview recipes from the web search

items.text: In Search the web, tap a recipe’s title to read it right inside the dashboard (photo, ingredients and steps) instead of opening a browser. Back to results, Import, and Open the site buttons sit at the top.
On the Settings page the Save and Cancel bar no longer floats above the bottom of the screen with buttons peeking out underneath it.
The Arrange bar on the Main page no longer shows the word “null” beside the Done button.

Sticky notes can now be handwritten. In Family notes tap “Write with your finger” to post a new one, or tap an existing note and choose it to write on that note. There are four pen colors, plus Undo and Clear.
Handwriting scales with the note when you drag its corner to resize it.
Drag the bottom-right corner of a family sticky note to make it bigger or smaller. The writing grows and shrinks with it, and the size is saved for everyone.

Press and hold the Sleep button for one second to turn the screen fully black. Tap anywhere to bring back the screensaver, and tap again to get back to the dashboard. On phones, Menu has a “Black out the screen” row.
The photo screensaver now shows “The Reiners” above the clock. Change or clear it in Settings, General.
Tap the arrange icon at the top of the Main page (or Settings, General, Arrange the Main page) to move cards up, down or between columns, and hide the ones you don't want.
Each person's layout is saved under their name, so it follows them to any phone, tablet or computer where they're picked under “This device is used by”. The shared screen keeps its own layout.
Settings is now five tabs instead of one long list: General, Alerts and texts, Guests and Face ID, Features, and History and info.
Save and Cancel stay at the bottom of the screen, and Settings reopens on the tab you were last on.
Apple Calendar events now show their notes, link and who's invited when you tap them.
Locations show under the event name and open in Maps when tapped.
The morning briefing text adds the location after each event.

Settings has a Morning briefing text section: a preview of a daily summary (weather, calendar, tasks due, reminders, tonight's dinner and the verse) and a private link an iPhone Shortcut can fetch each morning to text it to you.
A Spotify card on the Home page shows what is playing, with play/pause, next, previous, shuffle, a volume slider and a choice of device to play on.
Connect it once with a free Spotify developer app (needs SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID and SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET in Vercel). Controls need Spotify Premium.

title: Home page for cameras, lights and thermostat

items.text: The old Home page is now called Main. A new Home page holds Cameras, Philips Hue lights, the thermostat and other Home Assistant devices.

Lights have on/off switches and brightness sliders; the thermostat has temperature and mode controls; scenes, switches and blinds are one tap. Needs Home Assistant connected (see the setup card on the page).
Cameras moved from Settings and the Menu onto the Home page. Guest mode hides the Home page by default.
The Full screen button is hidden on phones. The Guests button has a new person icon.

title: Tasks: repeating section and drag to reorder

items.text: Repeating tasks now sit in a collapsible Repeating bar below each person's list.
Drag a task by its grip to reorder it, or drop it in another person's list to reassign it. Arrow keys work too.

title: History page and recipe web search

items.text: History page inside Settings: meals, finished tasks, finished reminders and grocery trips, with tabs and counts.
Search the web for recipes from the Meals search box and import a result in one tap (add a free BRAVE_SEARCH_KEY in Vercel for steady results).
Take off tonight button removes a dinner from tonight's card.
Change log in Settings (this page).
Morning reminders and task-due notifications are working now that the cron secret is set.
Every pop-up has an X button in its corner.
Meals on phones: Import, Paste and Snap fit on one line, filter chips scroll sideways, and the dinner plan controls fit on one row.
The meal search box has a subtle border so it is easy to spot.
The light/dark button is back in the top-right with its own icon; Sleep now shows Zzz; Full screen shows on every page; more space beside the calendar arrows.
Weekly dinner planner, search, favorites and tags (presets plus your own), and compact dish tiles.
Cooking mode: full-screen steps with an ingredient checklist and timers that read times from the steps.
Recipe names are tidied up (no stray parentheses).
Tasks can have a due day and time, an edit button, repeating schedules (including every 4th Sunday) and a notify-when-due option.
Weather pop-up shows rain and snow amounts by day and hour.
Guests are here mode: hides what you choose, unlocks with a 4-digit PIN.
Settings is a full page. Budget, History and Cameras moved into Settings; Guests and Sleep are top-right buttons; the Countdowns card shows every upcoming countdown.
The scrolling photo strip was removed from the main page.
